Configure a 2D simulation of flow past a cylinder using pimpleFoam for a transient, incompressible, laminar case.
The mesh is one cell thick in the out-of-plane direction.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, set the frontAndBack patches to type empty.
In the 0/U file, set the boundary condition for frontAndBack to type empty.
In the 0/p file, set the boundary condition for frontAndBack to type empty, keeping consistency across all field files.
Use a Reynolds number of 100.
Set the cylinder diameter D to 1 and the inlet velocity U to 1, so the kinematic viscosity nu is 0.01 in constant/transportProperties.
Keep the inlet, outlet, and cylinderWall boundary conditions as already set, appropriate for a flow-past-cylinder case.
Ensure the boundary types are consistent between constant/polyMesh/boundary and all 0/ field files.
Run the case with pimpleFoam as the solver.
